title: MESED: A Multi-modal Entity Set Expansion Dataset with Fine-grained Semantic Classes and Hard Negative Entities
reasoning: The paper introduces a new multi-modal entity set expansion task and constructs a dataset (MESED) for it. While the dataset includes fine-grained semantic classes like 'Theological Demons,' this is for evaluating the model's ability to distinguish between diverse semantic categories, not for evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as a core component of the research. There are no discussions of ethical implications or faith-related assessments.
